name: Parent–Teacher Meeting
description: A clear, warm deck for parents: the agenda, what children are learning this term, key dates, how parents can help at home, and questions.
audience: PTMs, parent orientations and open houses.

signals.why: your words describe a parents' meeting

slides.guidance: {topic}, with a subtitle naming the class and date.
The agenda: 3 or 4 things this meeting covers.
What the children are learning this term, in plain words for parents.
One highlight of the class this term that parents will be glad to hear. Only what the teacher's notes say; otherwise keep it general.
Key dates this term: tests, events, holidays. Only dates given by the teacher; otherwise [verify].
Simple ways parents can help at home, as steps.
Questions parents often ask, to open the floor.
How to reach the teacher, and the one thing to remember.
